title: CROSSTOWN
tagline: Walk, drive, and shoot through Midtown Manhattan on a courier job
description: You start on foot on 5th Avenue beside Madison Square Park with a pistol and a first job: get into a red coupe and collect a package at Broadway and E 23rd St. You can walk, run, jump, take the car, drive through traffic, crash, draw weapons, and attract police heat. A full-screen map, a fly camera, a grappling hook, rain, and a pause menu with graphics and key settings are also available.
features: Third-person movement on foot with mouse look, running, and jumping
Entering, driving, reversing, and leaving a car, with a speedometer and a body-damage bar
Job 01 objective chain with subtitles, a distance readout, and a route on the minimap
Moving traffic, cyclists, and pedestrians on streets labelled 5th Ave, Broadway, and Madison Av
Pistol and carbine with ammo counts, firing, aiming, and reloading
Police heat meter that rose after a crash and gunfire, with police shouts in subtitles
Collisions that stalled the engine and deformed the parked car that was hit
Full map of Manhattan with a legend for jobs, landmarks, subway stations, and pickups
Grappling hook that pulled the player through the air above the street
Fly camera above the city and a rain toggle
Pause menu with quality presets from Lowest to High and a rebindable key list

lineage.note: No source repository, starting state, seed digest, or runner record was supplied with the public deployment, so lineage cannot be established.

prompt.note: No build prompt or harness was supplied with the submission, and the deployment does not publish them.

presentation.coverAlt: A red coupe driving at 34 mph up 5th Avenue beside Madison Square Park, next to a white work van and other traffic.
controls: Click the game to capture the mouse, then move the mouse to look
W to walk forward or accelerate
A and D to sidestep on foot and steer in a car
Left Shift with a move key to run
F to get in or out of a car when the Get in prompt shows
1 for the pistol, 2 for the carbine, Q to put the gun away
Left mouse button to fire, right mouse button to aim, R to reload
C for the next camera in a car
Tab to open and close the city map
V to toggle the fly camera, W to move it forward
X to fire the grappling hook
P to open the pause menu
B to open the feedback form
limitations: The city is New York (Midtown Manhattan), not San Francisco
The model and build date are as stated by the submitter; no harness, prompt, source repository, or starting state was supplied
No code license is stated, asset credits come from the deployment's own credits file and were not independently checked, and no license was granted for the cover
The deployment shows a build stamp and a dated change list, so the game served at this URL may change
Played only in Chromium with software WebGL at under one frame per second; speed and feel on a graphics card were not observed
Audio was not heard; the sound toggle was confirmed only by its on-screen label
Job 01 was not finished: after getting in the car, it hit a parked car before reaching the package, directly and in the Mirage frame
No restart control was found; a fresh run needs a page reload and a download of about 150 MB
Played directly, the 3D view went black for two captures after the pistol fired while the HUD stayed, then recovered
Played directly, one asset request failed with HTTP 404: assets/hero/tsq-ads.webp
In the Mirage frame, the console reported two tainted-canvas texture errors, a failed tree-model worker, and one ground texture replaced by flat grey; play continued
N (time of day) and Z (flashlight) showed no clear change; G (horn) could not be judged without audio
Not tested: helicopter, motorcycles, buses, subway, radio, SMG, shotgun, punching, mouse wheel, arrow keys, key rebinding, and the three other maps
Controller and touch input were not tested
